brand.name: KXRA Group
brand.strapline: Useful AI, governed for real business.
brand.summary: KXRA is building a controlled operating platform that helps businesses turn ideas, evidence and brand knowledge into useful work.

capabilities.name: KXRA Brand Studio
capabilities.description: Turn reviewed brand evidence into editable campaign concepts and export-ready copy.

capabilities.name: Ask KXRA
capabilities.description: Search authorised project evidence and receive answers scoped to the project you can access.

capabilities.name: Custom projects
capabilities.description: Submit a business need for separate scoping, evidence review and commercial proposal.

commercialModel.subscription: Founding access is priced at £29 per organisation per month, with a £290 annual option. Checkout is not yet live.
commercialModel.subscriptionBoundary: The founding plan includes Brand Studio, 120 generated creative variants and 120 reviewed exports per month.
commercialModel.customProjects: Discovery, integrations and bespoke implementation are proposed and priced separately.
commercialModel.partnerAccess: KXRA may issue auditable free partner access without creating a paid subscription.
commercialModel.taxBoundary: Applicable VAT or other tax will be shown before purchase once the approved tax treatment is configured.
commercialModel.usageBoundary: Unused units do not roll over. Generated media, high-cost research, integrations, Ask KXRA and custom delivery are separate unless a later accepted plan explicitly includes them.

legalStatus: Public legal wording is a review placeholder and is not an activated customer agreement.
